entries.title: Buildora — Getting started with Buildora | Setup & Help
entries.text:
Start Buildora, create an account, save projects and connect free AI models or local Ollama. A practical setup guide.
Skip to content buildora . Workspace Templates Projects Pricing Guide Settings Log in Settings Log in Start building A FEW SIMPLE STEPS Let’s get you building. Open a workspace, save your first project and connect an AI provider only when you need one. 01 / Start the server Install Node.js 24 or newer. Open the project folder and run: npm install npm run build npm start Keep the terminal open, then visit the displayed address. For development use npm run dev . “Cannot reach server” means the full server is stopped, unreachable, or you are using a static preview. 02 / Create your account Create an account with an email identifier and a password of at least 10 characters. For the shared Supabase setup, follow the email confirmation and recovery links. A recovery code is used only in optional local-account mode. Use Save in the workspace, then Projects to reopen your work. 03 / Choose how to use AI The editor does not need AI. The easiest option is Settings: choose a provider, paste your own key, test the connection and select a model. Guest generation with your own key needs no account. Save and export require an account. For server-default generation, copy .env.example to .env and use one option: Free hosted model routes Create your own key at OpenRouter , then set OPENROUTER_API_KEY . Free-only routing is enabled by default. Free model availability and quotas vary; a key is not a promise of unlimited usage. Local models, no provider key Install Ollama , download a suitable coding model and set OLLAMA_MODEL to its installed name. Your computer needs enough memory and storage for that model. Buildora does not install or download a model automatically. Restart the server after editing environment settings. Secret provider keys stay on the server. No shared public API keys are included. 04 / Preview and take it with you HTML/CSS preview updates with edits. Node projects need a compatible current browser and a dev/start script. Choose Run project. Stop and run again after Node project edits; static previews update automatically. Export your files as a ZIP at any point. 05 / Templates and projects Browse templates , filter by category and open a detail page to preview its source. Use template replaces the current browser workspace after confirmation. Save your current work first. Planned premium templates cannot be purchased. My projects lets signed-in users open, rename, duplicate and delete saved work. Going live Use a persistent Node host for local accounts, mount the data directory on persistent storage, enable HTTPS, and set COOKIE_SECURE=true . Set SITE_URL and VITE_SITE_URL to your real domain and rebuild to activate canonical URLs and sitemap entries. Keep a backup of the database. For Supabase, set AUTH_PROVIDER=supabase and configure its URL and public publishable key on the server. The included SQL requires owner policies and explicit authenticated table grants; follow the supplied setup guide. Supabase and local accounts are separate stores. Open your workspace ↗ buildora . entries.title: Buildora — How Buildora handles your data
entries.text:
Understand where Buildora stores account information, project files and prompts, and when data is sent to AI providers.
Skip to content buildora . Workspace Templates Projects Pricing Guide Settings Log in Settings Log in Start building CLARITY ABOUT YOUR DATA Your work. Your information. This describes the included Buildora application. The operator of a publicly hosted instance must publish their own contact details, retention practices and applicable privacy policy. Accounts and saved work In local mode, account records, password hashes, hashed session tokens and saved projects live in a SQLite database on the server. Passwords are hashed with scrypt. Browser sessions use HttpOnly cookies. Recovery codes are hashed; keep the code shown at signup in a safe place. Your browser workspace The current workspace and theme are stored in your browser. Export files before clearing browser storage. Signing out resets the current workspace; account projects stay in the server database. AI requests When you send an AI request, your prompt and selected project context are sent to the configured model provider. Local Ollama requests go to the configured model server. Avoid including private credentials in project files or prompts. The selected provider’s data policies apply. External runtime and accounts Node previews use the WebContainer service and may access package registries. If Supabase is configured, authentication and saved projects use that Supabase project instead of the local database. Managing your files After signing in, you can export source files as a ZIP and delete saved projects from the workspace. Server operators manage database backups and account record deletion. This build does not include analytics or advertising trackers. Google Fonts receives a network request when fonts load. API keys and GitHub tokens entered in settings are held in tab memory and sent via the Buildora server only for requested provider actions; they are not stored in the database. buildora . Sessions and recovery codes are hashed in persistent SQLite storage. Project endpoints check ownership. Public deployments must enable HTTPS and secure cookies. Provider keys Keys entered in Settings are sent through the Buildora server to the chosen provider. They are not written to the account database or browser storage. Answers about Windows setup, wake words, internet access, mobile control, voice models and privacy. Does SARAS run on my phone? + The web app can be opened on a phone. PC actions and laptop-generated voices require a paired Windows companion that remains powered on and connected. Is the microphone always recording to the cloud? + Background wake-word processing runs locally. If enhanced recognition is enabled, an activated request can be sent through the SARAS server to Groq. Background wake audio is not uploaded by that feature. Is every language supported equally? + No. Recognition and pronunciation depend on the selected language, microphone and installed voice model. Aegis Urdu currently has verified model-derived speech timings. Other models can speak without that timing support. Can it control absolutely anything? + No. Supported tools and configured permissions define what it can do. Windows may require administrator approval for some actions. Turning Wi-Fi off can disconnect remote control. Can I stop it speaking? + Use the stop control or click the speaking desktop character. Voice interruption is also available; its reliability depends on the microphone and speaker echo. Is SARAS free and ready for public resale? + Pricing has not been announced. This is a private pilot, and some voice models have personal-use restrictions. The current bundle is not commercially cleared. What does lip sync mean here? + The desktop uses a two-dimensional character rig with mouth poses driven by speech timing where the selected voice supports it. It is not a fully rigged 3D animal or a guarantee of film-quality animation. How are updates delivered? + This pilot uses versioned releases. A signed, public automatic update service is not yet available. Always check the release source before installing an update. SARAS NEXT A little presence. A more capable computer.
